Coram : K.M. JOSEPH*, HRISHIKESH ROY
National Green Tribunal Act, 2010: ss. 14, 21 – Jurisdiction of the High Court, if ousted by the NGT – Held:Nothing contained in the NGT Act either impliedly or explicitly, ousts the jurisdiction of the High Courts u/Arts. 226 and 227 – Power remains intact and unaffected by the NGT Act –Prerogative of writ jurisdiction of High Courts is neither taken away nor it can be ousted, as it is a part of the basic structure of the Constitution – Constitution of India – Arts. 226 and 227. National Green Tribunal – Seat
Decision Date : 18-05-2022 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 433/2012 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
